# Kharji

> Personal finance tracker for logging expenses, income, and assets in one place, with multi-currency support and a bilingual Persian/English interface.

Kharji lets people track daily expenses by category, monthly income by type, and a wealth
portfolio across cash, crypto, commodities, vehicles, property, bank accounts, and investments.
Amounts can be entered in six currencies (Iranian Toman, US Dollar, Euro, British Pound, UAE
Dirham, Turkish Lira) with live exchange rates and historical per-date conversion. It also
includes spending reports, a net worth chart, recurring expenses, and a debts/credits ledger for
tracking money owed and money owed to you. The interface is available in Persian (default,
right-to-left) and English.
